findings.issue: LendCircle offers a default loss guarantee for loans facilitated over its platform, which is prohibited under RBI guidelines. NBFC-P2P shall not enter into DLG arrangements for the loans facilitated over its platform.
findings.doc_evidence: To attract lenders, LendCircle offers a default loss guarantee: it will reimburse lenders for up to 3% of the principal in each loan pool that goes bad.
findings.fix: Immediately discontinue the default loss guarantee feature and revise all marketing and contractual terms to ensure compliance with RBI guidelines prohibiting DLG arrangements.
findings.verifier_note: The RBI paragraph explicitly prohibits NBFC-P2P from entering into DLG (Debt-Lending Guarantee) arrangements for loans facilitated over their platform. The product feature describes a default loss guarantee, which is a form of DLG arrangement. Since the feature involves offering a guarantee for loans facilitated over the platform, it directly violates the prohibition stated in the RBI paragraph.

candidates.issue: The feature states that 'No phone permissions beyond one-time camera access for KYC' are used. However, the RBI paragraph requires that RE shall ensure that DLA of RE/LSP desist from accessing mobile phone resources like file and media, contact list, call logs, telephony functions, etc. A one-time access can be taken for camera, microphone, location or any other facility necessary for the purpose of on-boarding/KYC requirements only, with the explicit consent of the borrower. The feature does not explicitly mention that explicit consent is obtained for the one-time camera access, which is required by the RBI.

Since the feature does not contradict the RBI paragraph and does not explicitly violate any requirement, the claim that it violates the RBI paragraph is not valid.

summary: The compliance review of LendCircle: Peer-to-Peer Personal Loans identified several gaps against the reviewed RBI rules. The findings include: (1) The feature does not provide a digital view of all matching loan offers on the DLA, which is a medium severity issue. (2) The platform offers a default loss guarantee, which is prohibited under RBI guidelines, classified as a high severity issue. (3) The use of a third-party pass-through account for repayment violates the requirement for direct execution in the RE’s bank account, also a high severity issue. (4) The app home screen falsely implies RBI approval and backing, which is misleading and constitutes a high severity issue. No other gaps were found.
